Review window: 8 October 2011–8 October 2026; older project origins are explicitly context.

sources.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

sources.title: Union Government CAG Report 39 of 2025: MCL and NLC Tamil Nadu Power
sources.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
sources.excerpt: Paraphrase: MCL’s common-IP audit distinguishes weak controls from proven collusion and records HNPCL compensation billing/recovery. NTPL section identifies financing, contractors, delays and the disputed extent of liquidated-damages recovery.
limitations: Direct PDF request returned 503; inspected official-PDF Exa extraction. Extraction capped at 160,000 characters; selected Chapter I passages complete, later chapters not reviewed.

MCL and NTPL sections are not independent source families merely because they form different cases.

sources.title: NTPL rating update: debt reduction, tariff arrears and liquidated damages
sources.excerpt: Paraphrase: receipt of about ₹1,861 crore tariff arrears during October 2024–June 2025 helped reduce debt; ICRA reports about ₹7,212 crore project cost excluding ₹81 crore LD recovered, versus approved capital cost ₹6,004 crore and an APTEL appeal.
limitations: Credit opinion using company information, not a court finding or public bank ledger.
₹81 crore LD lacks a reconciliation to CAG’s ₹24.98 crore nine-contract recovery as of July 2024; scope and timing may differ.

sources.title: Adani Transmission Step-Six: co-obligor financing and collection waterfall
sources.locator: 17 March 2026 Detailed Rationale; Analytical Approach; Limited track record of DDF; Annexure instruments
sources.excerpt: Paraphrase: five named smart-meter SPVs share debt-service cash flows and cross-defaults; DDF prioritises undisputed service charges before the residual goes to discoms. ₹2,105 crore first group takeout facility raised December 2025. ₹850 crore ATSSL NCDs were yet to be issued.
limitations: Rating-agency account of agreements and management information; signed financing/DDF agreements and cash ledgers not inspected.
Rated facilities, issued debt, drawdown and revenue are different stages.
Group progress/ROW explanations and no penalties reported by management are not independently field-verified.

sources.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
sources.excerpt: Paraphrase: 31 test-checked QCBS works worth ₹679.25 crore; 16 works challenged rate clipping and CAG identifies ₹51.30 crore additional liability. Observation window ends 31 December 2025; pending items cannot be asserted still pending in October 2026.
Implementer self-report hosted by the lender, not an independent site audit.
